# stack

<!-- generated by `knowledge.mjs index` — do not edit -->

- [[bff-only-data-access]] — All data goes through server routes using the service-role key; the browser uses Supabase for auth only, and anon/authenticated get no grants. _(decision)_
- [[idempotent-migrations]] — Every SQL migration must be safely re-runnable — IF [NOT] EXISTS, guarded DO blocks, scoped backfills, ON CONFLICT seeds, drop old function signatures first. _(rule)_
- [[never-edit-committed-migrations]] — Once a migration file is committed it is frozen, even if not yet applied — fix forward with a new migration that redefines the object. _(rule)_
- [[nuxt-content-site]] — The "site" scaffold is one Nuxt app where every Markdown file in content/ is a page; colours live in app/assets/css/main.css; `npm run generate` builds static HTML. _(howto)_
- [[server-owned-user-data]] — A user's role and scope come only from a server-owned table; server-owned user fields go in app_metadata; never read user_metadata (users can edit it). _(rule)_
- [[shared-zod-schemas]] — Each module has row/create/update Zod schemas in packages/shared, used by the form, the server route (readValidatedBody) and tests — never duplicated. _(rule)_
